description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in beautiful St. Petersburg, FL, as a Full-time Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA). This facility, with 55-59 beds and a current census of 43, offers a vibrant work environment situated on a main street with convenient shopping nearby and a pleasant neighborhood behind the building. Enjoy the added perk of being just 15 minutes from the beach, perfect for unwinding after work. The center also features two courtyards, providing a serene atmosphere for both patients and staff. We are seeking a dedicated PTA to contribute to our patient-centered care model.

In this role, you will be an integral part of a compassionate team, providing essential therapy services to help patients regain mobility and improve their quality of life. We value our team members and offer a competitive hourly rate of $38.00 - $48.00, reflecting your expertise and commitment. This is an excellent opportunity to advance your career in a supportive and dynamic setting.

If you are a motivated Physical Therapist Assistant looking for a rewarding full-time position in a facility that prioritizes both patient well-being and employee satisfaction, we encourage you to apply. Become a part of a team dedicated to making a significant difference in the lives of our residents.
requirements: Valid Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license in the state of Florida.
Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility or rehabilitation setting preferred.
Ability to provide comprehensive physical therapy treatments under the supervision of a Physical Therapist.
Strong documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Commitment to patient-centered care and professional development.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $38.00 - $48.00, based on experience.

description:

The COO will be responsible for overseeing all operational aspects, ensuring efficiency, quality, and compliance across various departments. Key areas of focus include optimizing workflows, managing resources effectively, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. This role is critical in translating strategic vision into actionable plans and achieving organizational goals.
If you are a visionary leader with a proven track record in healthcare operations and a passion for enhancing patient care and organizational performance, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Management, or a related field (Master's preferred)
Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare operations
Demonstrated expertise in strategic planning, financial management, and operational efficiency
Strong understanding of healthcare regulations and compliance standards
Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills

description: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Regional Marketing Director to lead business development initiatives across multiple healthcare facilities in the Oklahoma City, OK area. roleTitle: Travel Labor and Delivery Registered Nurse (RN)
description:
Embark on a rewarding travel contract as a Labor and Delivery Registered Nurse in Tyler, TX. This is an excellent opportunity for a dedicated RN to provide specialized care to mothers and newborns in a dynamic hospital environment. You will play a crucial role in supporting families through one of life's most significant moments, ensuring safe and positive birthing experiences.

This contract position offers a competitive hourly rate of $50.71 and is scheduled to begin on July 13, 2026. Join a team committed to patient-centered care and make a significant impact while enjoying the flexibility and adventure of travel nursing.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Texas or a compact state
Basic Life Support (BLS) certification
Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS) certification
Neonatal Resuscitation Program (NRP) certification
Minimum of 1-2 years of recent Labor and Delivery experience

roleTitle: Travel Intensive Care Unit (ICU) Registered Nurse (RN)
description:
